in_tamil.name: அர்जித்தான்ஷ

in_marathi.name: Arjitansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Conquering the God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjitansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjitansh is a compound name derived from Arjit (conquering) and Ansh (God). This name signifies one who conquers or defeats the divine. In Hindu mythology, Arjitansh is the name of a brave and powerful warrior in the Mahabharata epic.
